description: This file defines the API and data structures for system power management policy in Zephyr OS, including latency management, power state locking, and event registration.

methods.name: pm_policy_next_state
methods.description: Function to get the next power management state based on CPU index and ticks to next event.

methods.name: pm_policy_state_lock_get
methods.description: Increase a power state lock counter to prevent entering certain power states.

methods.name: pm_policy_state_lock_put
methods.description: Decrease a power state lock counter.

methods.name: pm_policy_state_lock_is_active
methods.description: Check if a power state lock is active.

methods.name: pm_policy_latency_request_add
methods.description: Add a latency requirement to prevent system from entering power states exceeding specified latency.

methods.name: pm_policy_latency_changed_subscribe
methods.description: Subscribe to changes in maximum latency.

methods.name: pm_policy_event_register
methods.description: Register a system event that can wake the system.
